Evidence state: `NONE`; evidence hash: `4b4a035c11b064a0cec7dc29f2a08c3e2201868ce044d6cf53497d699ee04b34`

Support units:
- `E1.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E1.S2`: SUMMARY
 Vulnerability in Apache Commons FileUpload affects IBM WebSphere Service Registry and Repository (CVE-2016-1000031)
- `E1.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID: CVE-2016-1000031 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2016-1000031]
DESCRIPTION: Apache Commons FileUpload, as used in certain products, could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system, caused by deserialization of untrusted data in DiskFileItem class of the FileUpload library. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current process.
CVSS Base Score: 9.8
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/117957 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/117957] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H)
- `E1.S4`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
WebSphere Service Registry and Repository V8.5
WebSphere Service Registry and Repository V8.0
- `E1.S5`: For unsupported versions IBM recommends upgrading to a fixed, supported version of the product
- `E1.S6`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
To remediate CVE-2016-1000031 you need to apply fixes for both IBM WebSphere Application Server and IBM WebSphere Service Registry and Repository.
- `E1.S7`: For WebSphere Application Server updates refer to this bulletin:
Security Bulletin: Security vulnerability in Apache Commons FileUpload used by WebSphere Application Server (CVE-2016-1000031) [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22011428]
- `E1.S8`: For WebSphere Service Registry and Repository, this vulnerability has been fixed under APAR IJ01131. Fixes containing IJ01131 have been published and are available from Fix Central.
- `E1.S9`: For WSRR V8.5
- `E1.S10`: * Apply V8.5.6.1_IJ01131 [https://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/quickorder?product=ibm%2FWebSphere%2FWebSphere+Service+Registry+and+Repository&fixids=8.5.6.1-WS-WSRR-MultiOS-IFIJ01131]
- `E1.S11`: For WSRR V8.0  * Apply [http://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/quickorder?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/WebSphere+Service+Registry+and+Repository&function=fixId&fixids=8.0.0.3-WS-WSRR-MultiOS-IFIV65487_IV79085]V8.0.0.3_IV65487_IV79085_IV87422_IV87429_IV89477_IJ01131 [https://www.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/quickorder?product=ibm%2FWebSphere%2FWebSphere+Service+Registry+and+Repository&fixids=8.0.0.3-WS-WSRR-MultiOS-IFIV65487_IV79085_IV87422_IV87429_IV89477_IJ01131]

- `E2.S1`: security SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E2.S2`: SUMMARY
 Apache Commons FileUpload used by IBM Maximo Asset Management could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system, caused by deserialization of untrusted data in DiskFileItem class of the FileUpload library. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current process.
- `E2.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID: CVE-2016-1000031 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2016-1000031]
DESCRIPTION: Apache Commons FileUpload, as used in Novell NetIQ Sentinel and other products, could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the system, caused by deserialization of untrusted data in DiskFileItem class of the FileUpload library. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the current process. 
CVSS Base Score: 9.8
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/117957 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/117957] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L)
- `E2.S4`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
The following Apache Commons FileUpload version is affected:
- `E2.S5`: * Apache Commons FileUpload 1.3.2
- `E2.S6`: IBM supplied Apache Commons FileUpload with the following:
- `E2.S7`: The 7.5.0.x and 7.6.0.x versions of Maximo Asset Management bundled Apache Commons FileUpload 1.3.2
- `E2.S8`: This vulnerability affects the following versions of the IBM Maximo Asset Management core product, and all other IBM Maximo Industry Solution and IBM Control Desk products, regardless of their own version, if they are currently installed on top of an affected IBM Maximo Asset Management. *
- `E2.S9`: Maximo Asset Management core product affected versions: 
Maximo Asset Management 7.6, 7.5 
Maximo Asset Management Essentials 7.5
- `E2.S10`: Industry Solutions products affected if using an affected core version: 
Maximo for Aviation 
Maximo for Government 
Maximo for Life Sciences 
Maximo for Nuclear Power 
Maximo for Oil and Gas 
Maximo for Transportation 
Maximo for Utilities
- `E2.S11`: IBM Control Desk products affected if using an affected core version: 
SmartCloud Control Desk 
IBM Control Desk 
Tivoli Integration Composer
- `E2.S12`: * To determine the core product version, log in and view System Information. The core product version is the "Tivoli's process automation engine" version. Please consult the Product Coexistence Matrix [https://www.ibm.com/developerworks/community/wikis/home?lang=en#!/wiki/IBM%20Maximo%20Asset%20Management/page/Product%20compatibility] for a list of supported product combinations. REMEDIATION/FIXES
The recommended solution is to download the appropriate Interim Fix or Fix Pack from Fix Central (What is Fix Central? [http://www.ibm.com/systems/support/fixes/en/fixcentral/help/faq_sw.html]) and apply for each affected product as soon as possible. Please see below for information on the fixes available for each product, version, and release. Follow the installation instructions in the ‘readme’ documentation provided with each fix pack or interim fix.
- `E2.S13`: For Maximo Asset Management 7.6, 7.5:
- `E2.S14`: VRM Fix Pack, Feature Pack, or Interim Fix Download 7.6.0 Maximo 7.6.0.9 Interim Fix:
7.6.0.9-TIV-MBS-IFIX004 or latest Interim Fix available FixCentral [https://www-945.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=ibm~Tivoli&product=ibm/Tivoli/IBM+Maximo+Asset+Management&release=7.6.0.9&platform=All&function=all] 7.5.0 Maximo 7.5.0.11 Interim Fix:

Description: IBM WebSphere Application Server bundled with IBM Jazz Team Server and the CLM applications (RTC, RQM, RDNG), RELM, and Rhapsody DM is vulnerable to a denial of service in Apache Tomcat, caused by an error in the Apache Commons FileUpload component. By sending file upload requests, an attacker could exploit this vulnerability to cause the server to become unresponsive.

### techqa_DEV_Q150#row-0123

Question: Is Java 7 supported for BPM? What versions of BPM, if any,  support Java 7?

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, IBM Business Process Manager (BPM) supports Java 8 and later versions. There is a specific mention in the context about the need for support to use sqljdbc42.jar with Java 8 to connect to the Microsoft SQL Server database.

There is no direct mention of BPM supporting Java 7. The APARs and fixes mentioned in the context are related to fixing issues in BPM for Java 8 and later versions.

Therefore, it can be inferred that Java 7 is not supported for BPM and that Java 8 and later versions are the ones that are supported.

- `E3.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  When you place your inbound web service  inside a toolkit and
   one parameter is defined as a complex type list, the inbound
   web service generated WSDL contains an array type definition
   in a non-existent namespace and the runtime-generated SOAP
   message does not accomplish the WSDL definition. As a result,
   the web service client reports an error when loading the wrong
   WSDL or parsing the SOAP response message.

- `E3.S8`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:  IBM Business Process Manager (BPM)          *
   *                  Advanced                                    *
   *                  IBM BPM Express                             *
   *                  IBM BPM Standard                            *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: When you place your inbound web         *
   *                      service  inside a toolkit and one       *
   *                      parameter is defined as a complex       *
   *                      type list, the inbound web service      *
   *                      generated WSDL contains an array type   *
   *                      definition in a non-existent            *
   *                      namespace and the runtime-generated     *
   *                      SOAP message does not accomplish the    *
   *                      WSDL definition. As a result, the web   *
   *                      service client reports an error when    *
   *                      loading the wrong WSDL or parsing the   *
   *                      SOAP response message.                  *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   When you put the inbound web service inside a toolkit, the
   WSDL might use the namespace of the toolkit instead of the
   process application namespace. As a result, the array list
   items are created with the wrong namespace and wrong WSDL and
   a wrong SOAP message are generated.
- `E3.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that ensures the
   correct namespace is used no matter where the web service is
   placed.

 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:  All users of IBM WebSphere Application      *
   *                  Server V8.0 and V8.5 on Microsoft Windows   *

   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: Profile creation in Business Process    *
   *                      Management (BPM) fails with an          *

   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   Profile creation would fail with errors similar to:

- `E4.S7`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The OutOfMemoryError was resolved by increasing the maximum
   java heap size by changing -Xmx value to -Xmx512M.
- `E4.S8`: The fix for this APAR is currently targeted for inclusion in
   fix packs 8.0.0.4 and 8.5.0.1.
   Please refer to the Recommended Updates page for delivery
   information:
   http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=180&uid=swg27004980 [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=180&uid=swg27004980]
- `E4.S9`: TEMPORARY FIX
 *  In WAS_HOME/bin/manageprofiles.bat increase the maximum java
   heap size by changing -Xmx value to -Xmx512M.
   Note: WAS_HOME refers to the installation directory of
   WebSphere Application Server.

- `E2.S1`: ITCAM; appservers; prerequisites; CAMJ2ALL; CAMJ2ENV TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E2.S2`: QUESTION
 What application servers are supported by ITCAM for J2EE agent v7.1.1? What has changed if compared to the previous version of this product?
- `E2.S3`: ANSWER
These application servers and J2SE applications are supported:
- Apache Tomcat 4.x, 5.x, 6.x, 7.x 
- JBoss 3.x, 4.x, and 5.x
- Oracle WebLogic Server 9.x, 10.x, and 12.x; Oracle WebLogic Portal Server 9.x and 10.x
- SAP NetWeaver 7.0 (2004s), 7.1, 7.3, and 7.4
- J2SE applications
- `E2.S4`: JBoss EAP versions 6.1.0, 6.2.0, 6.3.0, and 6.4.0 support has been introduced starting from 7.1.1.0-TIV-ITCAM_J2EE-IF0003
- `E2.S5`: Support for versions highlighted in boldface is new in release 7.1.1
- `E2.S6`: Support for versions highlighted in italics had already been introduced starting from 6.1 FP6 and later interim-fixes (typically 6.1.0.6-TIV-ITCAMfJ2EE_MP-IF000x, see their readmes for details).
In fact J2EE v6.x has gone out of support at this point, so you will have to upgrade to v7.1.1.0.x to use a supported version.
- `E2.S7`: Java 7 support has been officially introduced in version 7.1.1.
Java 8 support has been introduced starting from 7.1.1.0-TIV-ITCAM_J2EE-IF0003
- `E2.S8`: The following application servers are not supported anymore in the J2EE agent 7.1.1:
- `E2.S9`: - Oracle/BEA Application Server
- Sun JSAS
- WebSphere Application Server Community Edition

- `E3.S4`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  When you place your inbound web service  inside a toolkit and
   one parameter is defined as a complex type list, the inbound
   web service generated WSDL contains an array type definition
   in a non-existent namespace and the runtime-generated SOAP
   message does not accomplish the WSDL definition. As a result,
   the web service client reports an error when loading the wrong
   WSDL or parsing the SOAP response message.

- `E3.S8`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:  IBM Business Process Manager (BPM)          *
   *                  Advanced                                    *
   *                  IBM BPM Express                             *
   *                  IBM BPM Standard                            *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: When you place your inbound web         *
   *                      service  inside a toolkit and one       *
   *                      parameter is defined as a complex       *
   *                      type list, the inbound web service      *
   *                      generated WSDL contains an array type   *
   *                      definition in a non-existent            *
   *                      namespace and the runtime-generated     *
   *                      SOAP message does not accomplish the    *
   *                      WSDL definition. As a result, the web   *
   *                      service client reports an error when    *
   *                      loading the wrong WSDL or parsing the   *
   *                      SOAP response message.                  *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   When you put the inbound web service inside a toolkit, the
   WSDL might use the namespace of the toolkit instead of the
   process application namespace. As a result, the array list
   items are created with the wrong namespace and wrong WSDL and
   a wrong SOAP message are generated.
- `E3.S9`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  A fix is available for IBM BPM V8.5.5.0 that ensures the
   correct namespace is used no matter where the web service is
   placed.

- `E2.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E2.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 The Daeja Virtual viewer works as expected when accessing the node that hosts the viewer directly. 
However when the viewer is launched using the Load Balancer URL, it fails to load at all and only a white screen is seen in its place.
- `E2.S3`: SYMPTOM
Seen in place of viewer and loaded document:
- `E2.S4`: [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22008878&aid=1] [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22008878&aid=1]
- `E2.S5`: CAUSE
Caching is enabled in the Websphere OnDemand Router (WAS ODR) and this causes WAS ODR to add its own cache control headers. These cache-control headers prevent the client PC from making the required callbacks to the back end webserver to obtain the resources it needs to start.
- `E2.S6`: ENVIRONMENT
Any load balanced environment using Webshere OnDemand Router (ODR)
- `E2.S7`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
To diagnose this issue, the developer tools in the browser need to be used to analyse the network requests.
- `E2.S8`: In the console log for the success case, you should see a call for "getViewoneBootstrap" - this call does not appear anywhere in the console in the failure case.
- `E2.S9`: From the network traces, the following differences can be seen:
- `E2.S10`: Request via Loadbalancer\ODR:
- `E2.S11`: HTTP/1.1 200 OK

- `E2.S14`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Disable the WAS ODR caching completely form the Admin console:
- `E2.S15`: Servers -> On Demand Routers -> <ODR server name> -> On Demand Router Settings -> On Demand Router Properties -> On Demand Router settings
-> Caching
From here, uncheck the "Enable caching" tick box.
- `E2.S16`: Restart the application in full for the setting to take effect.

 WAS ODR Caching Configuration [https://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/en/SSAW57_8.5.5/com.ibm.websphere.nd.doc/ae/tjpx_cachestatdyn.html]

 *  In star topologies, the P2P/SON bootstrap process can significan
- `E5.S5`: LOCAL FIX
 *  None:
- `E5.S6`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  ****************************************************************
   * USERS AFFECTED:  Users of IBM WebSphere Virtual Enterprise   *
   *                  leveraging multi-cell star topology         *
   *                  configurations.                             *
   ****************************************************************
   * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION: Immediately after start-up, the on      *
   *                      demand router (ODR) incorrectly         *
   *                      returns 404 error codes for certain     *
   *                      requests.                               *
   ****************************************************************
   * RECOMMENDATION:                                              *
   ****************************************************************
   In multi-cell star topology configurations, the service overlay
   network (P2P/SON) components bootstrap process can
   significantly slow the receipt of on demand configuration
   (ODC) data residing in linked remote cells. The delay in
   receiving ODC data can result in ODR processes incorrectly
   returning 404 error codes for some requests immediately
   after start-up.
- `E5.S7`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION
 *  The bootstrap process used by P2P/SON has been altered; the
   window which caused the delay in ODC data propagation is
   alleviated.
- `E5.S8`: This fix will be included in the next available fix pack for
   IBM WebSphere Virtual Enterprise.

- `E4.S3`: ERROR DESCRIPTION
 *  They got the message "Cannot invoke method toInteger( ) on null
   object"
   once dropping the ODR part on the pattern editor.
   It is an error only WCA which upgraded WCA from v1.1.1.0 GA code
   to v2.0.0.0 GA.
   When they use WCA 2.0 GA code with reset, this error does not
   occur.
   .
   Here is the steps taken during the migration from 1.1.1 GA.
   1. replace the firmware from v1.1.1.0 GA to v2.0.0.0 GA
   2. upload WAS HV 7.0.0.11 (RHEL) to WCA via
      CLI(cloudburst.virtualimage.create('local path of ova') )and
      Enabled IMP
   3. upload WAS HV 7.0.0.11(SLES) to WCA via CLI and Enabled IMP
   4. tried to create new pattern with ODR part, but failed with
      both RHEL and SLES ODR parts.
- `E4.S4`: LOCAL FIX
 *  reset the GA 2.0 firmware
- `E4.S5`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *  Title
- `E4.S6`: The On-Demand Router part is not usable in user interface when a
   WebSphere Cloudburst Appliance is upgraded to 2.0.0.0 and the
   WebSphere Hypervisor Edition with Intelligent Management Pack
   image is imported
- `E4.S7`: Error description
   The problematic scenario is when:
   (1) WebSphere Cloudburst Appliance is upgraded to version
   2.0.0.0
   (2) Then the new WebSphere Hypervisor Edition with the
   Intelligent Management Pack virtual image is imported, the
   license is accepted, and the Intelligent Management pack support
   is enabled.
   (3) Then when you attempt to drag and drop a  On demand router
   part onto the pattern. The pattern no longer can be displayed
   and a "Cannot invoke method toInteger( ) on null object"
   message is displayed.
- `E4.S8`: Local fix
   There is no workaround for this issue.
- `E4.S9`: Problem summary
   ****************************************************************
- `E4.S10`: * USERS AFFECTED:
   Users upgrading a WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance from releases
   prior to 2.0.0.0 to 2.0.0.0, who then import a new WebSphere
   Hypervisor Edition virtual image.
   ****************************************************************
- `E4.S11`: * PROBLEM DESCRIPTION:
   In previous releases of WebSphere CloudBurst appliance, the On
   Demand Router part is no included. This is actually two parts,
   an abstract conceptual part, and a specific concrete"part
   associated with a particular WebSphere Hypervisor Edition
   virtual image. The upgrade from WebSphere CloudBurst 2.0.0.0
   does not add the conceptual part to the WebSphere CloudBurst
   Appliance. WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance is unable to construct
   a consistent pattern model, and the message "Cannot invoke
   method toInteger( ) on null object"  is the result.
   ****************************************************************
- `E4.S12`: Problem conclusion
   The WebSphere CloudBurst Appliance 2.0.0.1 upgrade includes the
   addition of the On Demand Router conceptual part to the
   WebSphere Cloudburst appliance.
   If this upgrade is applied, the problem is resolved.
- `E4.S13`: PROBLEM CONCLUSION

### techqa_DEV_Q284#row-0102

Question: iLMT - incomplete virtualisation hierarchy 

this query is regarding support case 1109598 that has been raised.

If we set up an account is this providing access to information for other accounts/servers where we use the same ESX hosts for multiple customers. What specifically is being asked in terms of logical structure and permissions of the account?

Reference / gold answer:
The question is asking for clarification on the setup and permissions of an account in a scenario where the same ESX hosts are used for multiple customers. Specifically, the query is about the virtualization hierarchy, logical structure, and permissions associated with the account to ensure that it provides access to information for other accounts and servers in this multi-customer environment.

Reference relevant evidence:


=== ON / BGE ===

Evidence state: `NONE`; evidence hash: `ce92ef9431e07628e447bd829a5722e2e3c800be5b220a88684928744abdec36`

Support units:
- `E1.S1`: ClearCase; ALBD; 1296744 TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E1.S2`: QUESTION
 Is it possible to use two different IBM® Rational® ClearCase® privileged user (clearcase_albd) accounts for accessing the VOB server?
- `E1.S3`: CAUSE
- `E1.S4`: You want to use two different albd accounts for accessing your VOB server.
- `E1.S5`: You want to change the albd account and during the transition phase there will be two accounts present.
- `E1.S6`: Review the ClearCase Administrators Guide on the topic of The Rational ClearCase server process user [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/cchelp/v7r0m1/index.jsp?topic=/com.ibm.rational.clearcase.cc_admin.doc/topics/c_access_usr_grp_privileged_ccspu.htm]for more information about this account.
- `E1.S7`: ANSWER
- `E1.S8`: Yes this is possible.
- `E1.S9`: When using multiple ALBD user accounts, the key consideration is that the accounts need to be as close to identical as possible as described below.
- `E1.S10`: Key Considerations
- `E1.S11`: * If the VOBs are on a UNIX®/Linux® server, then the Microsoft® Windows® albd accounts need to map over to the same VOB-owner account that is using Samba or TAS. If for some reason this is not possible, see Note 3 below.
- `E1.S12`: Review the ClearCase Administrators Guide on the topic of Mapping the Rational ClearCase server process user [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/cchelp/v7r0m1/index.jsp?topic=/com.ibm.rational.clearcase.cc_admin.doc/topics/t_pcnfssmb_smb_samba_mapccspu.htm] for more information.
- `E1.S13`: * The albd accounts must be members of the same groups. Especially the "ClearCase Server Process Group," also known as the "ClearCase" or "ClearCase Administrators' group."
- `E1.S14`: Two common use cases for multiple albd accounts 
 1. Security policies require ALL accounts to change their passwords every "n" days, including service accounts.
- `E1.S15`: In this case, the albd account is "rotated" every "n-7" days from a workstation logged in with domain administration rights. This can be done using a simple script.
- `E1.S16`: DISCLAIMER:
    All source code and/or binaries attached to this document are referred to here as "the Program". IBM is not providing program services of any kind for the Program. IBM is providing the Program on an "AS IS" basis without warranty of any kind. IBM WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTUAL, DIRECT, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES OR FOR ANY ECONOMIC CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING LOST PROFITS OR SAVINGS), EVEN IF IBM, OR ITS RESELLER, HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
    -------------------------
- `E1.S17`: for /f "delims=:" %%x in ('cleartool lsclient -host {registry server} -type all ^| findstr "Windows"') do sc \\%%x config albd obj= {new_account} password= {new_acct_password} & sc \\%%x stop albd & sc \\%%x start albd
- `E1.S18`: -------------------------
- `E1.S19`: Note 1: The spaces after "obj=" and "password=" are significant and will cause the command to error if they are excluded.
- `E1.S20`: Note 2: This script makes no allowance for machines that are not currently active. A "production-ready" script would include the ability to account for this and also keep track of which ClearCase hosts have had their albd account "rotated" in order to avoid the problem. 
    Refer to the sc Windows on-line help for the "sc qc" command for more information on how to verify the account information for a service.

- `E2.S1`: TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)
- `E2.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 A user account that was originally created in the IBM Sterling B2B Integrator (SBI) user interface was assigned an IBM Sterling File Gateway (SFG) partner's Identity in the user account. When that user account logs in to My File Gateway and clicks on the dropdown arrow for the Mailbox Path field on the Upload Files tab, there are a number of mailboxes showing instead of just the main mailbox of the SFG partner.
- `E2.S3`: SYMPTOM
Multiple, unrelated mailboxes appear as options in the dropdown list for the Mailbox Path field of the Upload Files tab in My File Gateway
- `E2.S4`: CAUSE
There are two parts to the cause. The first part is that at least one of the groups of which the User Account is a member has permissions to specific mailboxes. Those are the extra mailboxes showing in the dropdown list. The other part is that, as the user account was not created automatically by creating a partner in the SFG user interface, no virtual root was automatically assigned to it, so it shows every mailbox that the user account has permissions to either directly or through its group memberships.
- `E2.S5`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
There are two choices to resolve the problem. Choose the one that best fits your needs.
- `E2.S6`: Option 1: Create a virtual root for the user account. The advantage to this method is it is specific to the user account. The potential disadvantage is that the user account will only have access to its virtual root mailbox and its sub-mailboxes, even if it needs access to some of the other mailboxes. Create the virtual root by doing the following:
- `E2.S7`: 1. Edit the user account and write down the value in the Identity field. For this example, assume it is Partner537. 
 2. Go to Deployment > Mailboxes > Virtual Roots in the SBI menu. 
 3. Create a virtual root using /Partner537 as the mailbox.
- `E2.S8`: Option 2: Remove the specific mailbox permissions in all groups that the user account is a member of. The advantage to this is it will likely allow you to take care of multiple user accounts in one process. The potential disadvantage is that if any of the members of that group really do need access to all of the mailboxes that the group specifically has permissions to, they will lose them. Change the groups' permissions by doing the following:
- `E2.S9`: 1. Edit the User account and write down all the items showing in the Assigned box of the Groups screen, then click Cancel. 
 2. Go to Accounts > Groups in the SBI menu. 
 3. Type the name of one of the groups written down above in the Group Name field and click Go! 
 4. Click "edit" 
 5. Click the Next button until you are at the Assign Permissions screen. 
 6. Remove all mailbox entries from the Assigned box, then click Save. 
 7. Click Finish. 
 8. Repeat steps 3-7 for all the other groups that the user account is a member of.
- `E2.S10`: NOTE: No method exists for leaving the specific permissions in the groups, but also giving the user account access through My File Gateway to two or more mailboxes that have only the root mailbox as a common ancestor.
- `E2.S11`: Click "edit" 
 5. Click the Next button until you are at the Assign Permissions screen. 
 6. Remove all mailbox entries from the Assigned box, then click Save. 
 7. Click Finish. 
 8. Repeat steps 3-7 for all the other groups that the user account is a member of.
- `E2.S12`: NOTE: No method exists for leaving the specific permissions in the groups, but also giving the user account access through My File Gateway to two or more mailboxes that have only the root mailbox as a common ancestor.
- `E3.S1`: STEwebcastDocument; lste_webcast; Tech Exchange; STEwebcast; openmic call; open microphone call; discussion; conference call; customer call; Citrix; submit; ask the experts; discuss; open mic; questions; answers; questions and answers; q&a; replay; recording; webcast; FAQ; best practice; transcript; IBM Lotus Notes on Citrix environments WEBCAST
- `E3.S2`: ABSTRACT
 IBM hosted an Open Mic Webcast with Lotus Development and Support Engineers on 28 September 2011. The topic was "IBM Lotus Notes in Citrix XenApp environments." Check back for the Q&A transcript.
- `E3.S3`: CONTENT
- `E3.S4`: For more information about our Open Mic webcasts, visit the IBM Collaboration Solutions Support Open Mics [http://www.ibm.com/software/lotus/support/lotus-open-mics/] page.
- `E3.S5`: Presentation & Audio Recording 
Presentation 
[/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27022065&aid=2]OpenMic_NotesCitrix_09_28_2011.pdf [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg27022065&aid=1]
- `E3.S6`: Audio recording 
Lotus_Notes_on_Citrix_XenApp_OpenMic_Sept282011.mp3 [ftp://public.dhe.ibm.com/software/lotus/info/notes/Lotus_Notes_on_Citrix_XenApp_OpenMic_Sept282011.mp3]
- `E3.S7`: Q&A 
Q. Since ID Vault is not supported in Citrix environments until Notes 8.5.3, does that mean it’s known to not work in prior versions? 
A. The statement about support of 8.5.3 just implies that we tested it formally in 8.5.3 and that no testing has been done on previous releases. It doesn’t mean that if used prior to 8.5.3 you’ll find any issues or that there are functional issues with it.
- `E3.S8`: Q. I’m planning to upgrade a Notes installation on a Presentation Server 4.5 from Notes 7.0.2 to 8.5.2 Fix Pack 1. Any advice or pitfalls or best practices we should be aware of prior to doing that? Is an upgrade preferable or a clean install? 
A . With 7.0.2 you should have had the Single User Install because we didn’t support multi-user until 8.5.1, so I would recommend uninstalling Notes 7.x and then doing an install of Notes 8.5.1 or 8.5.2. Then, any subsequent upgrades you could just do an in-place upgrade without backing out the previous build.
- `E3.S9`: Q.Intermittently, users are not able to log in and we receive an error message that “the Administration program could not be used while the Domino server is running”. 
A. I’ve found that if users completely terminate their ICA session that will leave Notes running in their session. And when the user tries to launch Notes again the error will occur.
- `E3.S10`: If you’re publishing it as an application, advise users to do a File > Exit to cleanly close the ICA session and to avoid leaving ghost sessions on the XenApp server. You may also want to check with Citrix to see if they have suggestions on handling cases where ICA sessions are terminated but the processes are still running.
- `E3.S11`: Q. Regarding the recommendation to leverage file server roaming capability where possible, is Domino roaming preferred for that versus Domino file server roaming? For example we want to implement using Domino server because we think it’s easier and we’ve already got a connection established to the mail server to roam to that server, but in the presentation the recommendation was to leverage file server roaming. 
A. You can use either one. The presentation focused on file server roaming because you can implement it using a policy and you don’t need to have a Domino application installed on that server in order to set it up as a roaming server.
- `E4.S1`: SECURITY BULLETIN
- `E4.S2`: SUMMARY
 An administration command can cause IBM MQ to access an invalid memory address, leading to a segmentation failure and causing the queue manager to become unresponsive.
- `E4.S3`: VULNERABILITY DETAILS
CVEID: CVE-2016-8971 [http://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2016-8971]
DESCRIPTION: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated user with queue manager permissions to cause a segmentation fault. This would result in the machine needing to be rebooted to resume normal operations.
CVSS Base Score: 5.3
CVSS Temporal Score: See https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/118862 [https://exchange.xforce.ibmcloud.com/vulnerabilities/118862] for the current score
CVSS Environmental Score*: Undefined
CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H)
- `E4.S4`: AFFECTED PRODUCTS AND VERSIONS
IBM MQ V9.0 Long Term Support Release
- `E4.S5`: IBM MQ V9.0.0.0 only.
- `E4.S6`: IBM MQ V8.0
- `E4.S7`: IBM MQ V8.0.0.0 - V8.0.0.5 maintenance levels.
- `E4.S8`: REMEDIATION/FIXES
IBM MQ V9.0 Long Term Support Release
- `E4.S9`: Apply 9.0.0.1 [https://www-945.ibm.com/support/fixcentral/swg/selectFixes?parent=ibm%7EWebSphere&product=ibm/WebSphere/WebSphere+MQ&release=9.0.0.1&platform=All&function=all&useReleaseAsTarget=true] maintenance level.
- `E4.S10`: IBM MQ V8.0
- `E4.S11`: Apply 8.0.0.6 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21995100] maintenance level.
- `E4.S12`: WORKAROUNDS AND MITIGATIONS
None.

- `E2.S1`: ClearCase; ALBD; 1296744 TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E2.S2`: QUESTION
 Is it possible to use two different IBM® Rational® ClearCase® privileged user (clearcase_albd) accounts for accessing the VOB server?
- `E2.S3`: CAUSE
- `E2.S4`: You want to use two different albd accounts for accessing your VOB server.
- `E2.S5`: You want to change the albd account and during the transition phase there will be two accounts present.
- `E2.S6`: Review the ClearCase Administrators Guide on the topic of The Rational ClearCase server process user [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/cchelp/v7r0m1/index.jsp?topic=/com.ibm.rational.clearcase.cc_admin.doc/topics/c_access_usr_grp_privileged_ccspu.htm]for more information about this account.
- `E2.S7`: ANSWER
- `E2.S8`: Yes this is possible.
- `E2.S9`: When using multiple ALBD user accounts, the key consideration is that the accounts need to be as close to identical as possible as described below.
- `E2.S10`: Key Considerations
- `E2.S11`: * If the VOBs are on a UNIX®/Linux® server, then the Microsoft® Windows® albd accounts need to map over to the same VOB-owner account that is using Samba or TAS. If for some reason this is not possible, see Note 3 below.
- `E2.S12`: Review the ClearCase Administrators Guide on the topic of Mapping the Rational ClearCase server process user [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/cchelp/v7r0m1/index.jsp?topic=/com.ibm.rational.clearcase.cc_admin.doc/topics/t_pcnfssmb_smb_samba_mapccspu.htm] for more information.
- `E2.S13`: * The albd accounts must be members of the same groups. Especially the "ClearCase Server Process Group," also known as the "ClearCase" or "ClearCase Administrators' group."
- `E2.S14`: Two common use cases for multiple albd accounts 
 1. Security policies require ALL accounts to change their passwords every "n" days, including service accounts.
- `E2.S15`: In this case, the albd account is "rotated" every "n-7" days from a workstation logged in with domain administration rights. This can be done using a simple script.
- `E2.S16`: DISCLAIMER:
    All source code and/or binaries attached to this document are referred to here as "the Program". IBM is not providing program services of any kind for the Program. IBM is providing the Program on an "AS IS" basis without warranty of any kind. IBM WILL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTUAL, DIRECT, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, OR INDIRECT DAMAGES OR FOR ANY ECONOMIC CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING LOST PROFITS OR SAVINGS), EVEN IF IBM, OR ITS RESELLER, HAS BEEN ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES.
    -------------------------
- `E2.S17`: for /f "delims=:" %%x in ('cleartool lsclient -host {registry server} -type all ^| findstr "Windows"') do sc \\%%x config albd obj= {new_account} password= {new_acct_password} & sc \\%%x stop albd & sc \\%%x start albd
- `E2.S18`: -------------------------
- `E2.S19`: Note 1: The spaces after "obj=" and "password=" are significant and will cause the command to error if they are excluded.
- `E2.S20`: Note 2: This script makes no allowance for machines that are not currently active. A "production-ready" script would include the ability to account for this and also keep track of which ClearCase hosts have had their albd account "rotated" in order to avoid the problem. 
    Refer to the sc Windows on-line help for the "sc qc" command for more information on how to verify the account information for a service.

 *  Problem Description: Unable to manage LDAPx accounts. When
   loggin in as
   a regular ITIM user that manages an LDAPX account, you are
   unable to
   change the password and do other changes to the account even
   though an
   ACI is in place granting all permissions. In fact the account
   doesn't
   even show up under 'Manage Passwords' at all. To debug this
   issue both
   I and the customer ran DocTool and when we looked at the ACI for
   the
   LDAPX account type the only attribute given read/write
   permissions was
   'labeleduri'. Even though the GUI shows all permissions being
   granted.
   Customer Recreate: See steps below.
   Desired Behavior: That ACI permit ITIM users to manage their
   LDAPX
   accounts.
   Your Steps to Duplicate:
   1. Install LDAPX agent 4.5.5 build 4.5.1011
   2. Install profile on ITIM server. I recreated on 4.5.1 FP16
   IF19
   3. Go to 'My Organization'->'Control Access'. Then 'Add' a new
   ACI.
   4. Select 'Account' and then make the Customer Class '
   XLdapAccount'.
   6. IN the ACI make the scope 'Subtree', under operation grant
   everything
   and under 'Attribute Permissions' grant everything for read and
   write.
   7. Make sure "Allow Self' is set to 'Yes' and then save.
   8. Do recon to get accounts with the agent and then adopt orphan
   account
   to an ITIM user.
   9. Login as the ITIM user that adopted one of thes LDAPX
   accounts.
   10. You should not see the account under manage passwords, you
   may see
   it undermanage accounts.
   11. Run DocTool and then look at the info for the ACI you
   created.It
   will show that only the 'labeleduri' attribue has any
   permissions set.
   ITIM SERVER RELEASE: 4.5.1.5183
   Environment:
      Operating System  : Win2k/AIX5.2
      enrole/ITIM version  : enRole 4.5.1.5183
      interim release installed: IF19
      Database server   : DB2 8.1
      Directory server  : IDS 5.1
      WebServer         : WAS 5.02
      Java Version         : 1.3.1_06
      Other software?      : no
      Agent(s) installed?  : LDAPX 4.5.1011
   **********************************************
- `E3.S4`: LOCAL FIX

- `E3.S5`: PROBLEM SUMMARY
 *   This is a documentation change for the ITIM
   Configuration Guide.  Please use the following information:
   The "CustomLabels.properties" in "$ITIM_HOME\Data" folder needs
   to be modified to correct this problem.  The LDAPX Agent has
   two password attributes, erpassword and userpassword.  Only one
   exists in the CustomLabels.properties file  To correct the
   problem, edit the CustomLabels.properties file in
   <ITIM_HOME>\Data" folder and find the line:
   userpassword=Password           and change that to:
   userpassword=User Password      also look for the line
   erpassword=Password             and ensure erpassword=Password
   Note: The solution shown above has been provided only for the
   English language. If a different language pack is installed on
   the system, then user needs to edit the
   words to accomodate the language used.

 *   The ITIM Configuration Guide will be updated
   to provide the configuration information needed.

The evidence describes an IBM Sterling B2B Integrator/Sterling File Gateway user account, not an ESX-host virtualization account. A user without an automatically assigned virtual root can see every mailbox to which the account has permissions, either directly or through group membership; this can expose unrelated mailboxes in My File Gateway. [E1.S2] [E1.S3] [E1.S4]

The requested logical structure is a virtual root based on the account’s Identity value. For example, if the Identity is Partner537, create the virtual root mailbox /Partner537. This restricts the account to that virtual-root mailbox and its sub-mailboxes. [E1.S6] [E1.S7]

### techqa_DEV_Q007#row-0076

Question: Which Socket Gateway should I be using with Netcool Omnibus (NOI) ? Which Socket Gateway should I be using with Netcool Omnibus (NOI) ?

There are 2 versions of the gateway; nco-g-socket-java-2_0 and nco-g-socket-10_0 Users may be confused what version they should download or use 

Reference / gold answer:
The Socket Gateway that should be used with Netcool Omnibus (NOI) depends on the version of Netcool/OMNIbus being used:

- For Netcool/OMNIbus V8.1, the recommended Socket Gateway is nco-g-socket-java-2_0.
- For Netcool/OMNIbus V7.4.0, the legacy Socket Gateway to be used is nco-g-socket-10_0.

Reference relevant evidence:

- `2i`: If you are running Netcool/OMNIbus V7.4.0, a separate package is supplied for each Operating System.

- `E3.S1`: release notice; downloads; nco-p-socket-java; Socket Java Probe NEWS
- `E3.S2`: ABSTRACT
 The Netcool/OMNIbus Socket Java Probe will be available to download from December 10, 2015.
- `E3.S3`: CONTENT
- `E3.S4`: This is a new socket probe that can be configured to work in either Client mode or Server mode. In Server mode, the probe is a multiheaded probe that acts as a single process concurrent server which accepts multiple client connections. In Client mode, the probe connects to a socket to which a device writes its events.
- `E3.S5`: This probe has been created to address the following enhancement requests:
- `E3.S6`: * RFE 43179, RFE 50920, RFE 61527: A secure connection can be established using the new Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) feature. This probe supports TLSv1 protocol.
 * RFE 36469: The ParserElementDelimiter property now accepts Java Regular Expression, allowing users to specify multiple characters as delimiters. This enhancement is also applicable to the new ParserNVPDelimiter property to tokenize name-value pairs.
 * RFE 53841: The probe can now be configured to receive heartbeat messages to avoid entering into the Inactivity state.
- `E3.S7`: You can download the installation package from the IBM Passport Advantage website: 
www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/pao_customers.htm [http://www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/pao_customers.htm]

- `E5.S2`: ABSTRACT
 This document describes how to download IBM Tivoli Network Manager IP Edition version 3.9 from the IBM Passport Advantage Online Web site.
- `E5.S3`: DOWNLOAD DESCRIPTION
- `E5.S4`: [http://www.ibm.com/i/c.gif] IBM Tivoli Network Manager IP Edition discovers networks, including layer 2 and 3 network devices, interfaces and connectivity. Network Manager also integrates topology and alert data with IBM Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus so that operators can visualize and understand the layout of complex networks, and diagnose and solve network problems in real time.
- `E5.S5`: After logging into IBM's Passport Advantage Online [http://www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/pao_customers.htm] Web site, click Software download & media access, then click Download finder, then select Find by product description and type in Tivoli Network Manager. Expand the Tivoli Software eAssembly, and select the images you wish to download from that list. All Tivoli Network Manager IP Edition download images are described below.
- `E5.S6`: Downloading and assembling the product
- `E5.S7`: 1. Download all of the parts that you need, both required and optional. The parts are listed by operating system in the tabs below. 
 2. Unpack each of the parts into a single temporary directory on your system. If you want Network Manager to install IBM Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus, do not rename the Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus package.
 3. Follow the instructions in the Quick Start Guide to install the product.
- `E5.S8`: To see the part numbers for your platform, click the appropriate link below.

- `E1.S1`: release note; downloads; nco-g-socket-java; Java Gateway for Socket NEWS
- `E1.S2`: ABSTRACT
 A new version of the Netcool/OMNIbus Socket Gateway will be available to download from August 6, 2015.
- `E1.S3`: CONTENT
- `E1.S4`: You can access the latest version of the guide written for this gateway on the IBM Knowledge Center:
- `E1.S5`: www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSSHTQ/omnibus/gateways/socketjavagw/wip/concept/socketjavagw_instl_cnfgr_gateway.html [http://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSSHTQ/omnibus/gateways/socketjavagw/wip/concept/socketjavagw_instl_cnfgr_gateway.html]
- `E1.S6`: You can download the installation package from the IBM Passport Advantage website: 
www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/pao_customers.htm [http://www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/pao_customers.htm]
- `E1.S7`: Netcool/OMNIbus V8.1
- `E1.S8`: The Netcool/OMNIbus V8.1 version of this gateway supports the following Operating Systems:
- `E1.S9`: AIX, Linux, Solaris, Windows and zLinux.

- `E1.S11`: Netcool/OMNIbus V7.4.0
- `E1.S12`: If you are running Netcool/OMNIbus V7.4.0, a separate package is supplied for each Operating System. To obtain this new package, use the Find by part number field to search for the part number that corresponds to your Operating System as shown in the table below.

- `E2.S1`: release notice; downloads; nco-p-socket-java; Socket Java Probe NEWS
- `E2.S2`: ABSTRACT
 The Netcool/OMNIbus Socket Java Probe will be available to download from December 10, 2015.
- `E2.S3`: CONTENT
- `E2.S4`: This is a new socket probe that can be configured to work in either Client mode or Server mode. In Server mode, the probe is a multiheaded probe that acts as a single process concurrent server which accepts multiple client connections. In Client mode, the probe connects to a socket to which a device writes its events.
- `E2.S5`: This probe has been created to address the following enhancement requests:
- `E2.S6`: * RFE 43179, RFE 50920, RFE 61527: A secure connection can be established using the new Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) feature. This probe supports TLSv1 protocol.
 * RFE 36469: The ParserElementDelimiter property now accepts Java Regular Expression, allowing users to specify multiple characters as delimiters. This enhancement is also applicable to the new ParserNVPDelimiter property to tokenize name-value pairs.
 * RFE 53841: The probe can now be configured to receive heartbeat messages to avoid entering into the Inactivity state.
- `E2.S7`: You can download the installation package from the IBM Passport Advantage website: 
www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/pao_customers.htm [http://www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/pao_customers.htm]
- `E2.S8`: You can access the latest version of the guide written for this probe on the IBM Knowledge Center:
- `E2.S9`: www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSSHTQ/omnibus/probes/socket_java/wip/concept/socket_java_intro.html [https://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSSHTQ/omnibus/probes/socket_java/wip/concept/socket_java_intro.html]
- `E2.S10`: Netcool/OMNIbus V8.1
- `E2.S11`: This probe is only supported on Netcool/OMNIbus V8.1. It is provided as a single package which contains versions of the probe for all supported Operating Systems. To obtain this new package, use the Find by part number field to search for part number: CN8BAEN
- `E2.S12`: Netcool/OMNIbus V7.4.0
- `E2.S13`: If you are running Netcool/OMNIbus V7.4.0, you must use the legacy Socket Probe (nco-p-socket-10_0). For details see 
www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21613418 [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21613418]

- `E5.S1`: DOWNLOADABLE FILES
- `E5.S2`: ABSTRACT
 This document describes how to download and install IBM Netcool Network Management V9.2 using the Passport Advantage website.
- `E5.S3`: DOWNLOAD DESCRIPTION
- `E5.S4`: Netcool Network Management provides network discovery and event and network management, including identification and resolution of root-causes and system, network, and service failures, and configuration management capabilities for network devices. Inventory and connectivity data is integrated with IBM Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus event data. Network management staff can visualize and understand the layout of complex networks and the impact of network events and failures, and work with events to locate, diagnose, and solve network problems in real time.
- `E5.S5`: Netcool Network Management consists of the following products: IBM Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus V7.4, IBM Tivoli Network Manager IP Edition V3.9, and IBM Tivoli Netcool Configuration Manager V6.4.
- `E5.S6`: More information
- `E5.S7`: The libraries of publications for the products in Netcool Network Management are available from this website: IBM Tivoli Network Management Information Center [http://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/SSNFET].
- `E5.S8`: Downloading and assembling the product
- `E5.S9`: 1. Navigate your browser to the Find Downloads and Media [http://www.ibm.com/software/howtobuy/passportadvantage/paocustomer/sdma/SDMA?PO=DOWNLOAD_FIND_BY_PART_NUMBER] page on the IBM Passport Advantage Online website. You must log on to continue. 
 2. Select the Find by part number search option under Download finder options. 
 3. Search for each downloadable image by part number (parts are listed and described by operating system in the tabbed section of this document). 
 4. Download all of the parts that you need.
 5. Unpack each of the parts into a single temporary directory on your system. If you want to install Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus as part of the Network Manager installation process, you must download the Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus installation package to a specific location and point the Network Manager installer to that location. Do not extract or rename the Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus installation package.
 6. Open the Quick Start image and follow the instructions in the Quick Start Guide to install the base product.

### techqa_DEV_Q014#row-0035

Question: Installing fixpacks with Installation Manager - when did it change from using updateInstaller,  starting in which version of WebSphere I was using updateInstaller to install fixpacks, and there was a separate fixpack for WebSphere and separate for the JDK, independent of each other. Now I understand that with Installation Manager there is a single package containing both the WebSphere App server fixpack as well as the JDK. When did this occur, starting with which version of WebSphere ? 

Reference / gold answer:
The change to using Installation Manager to install fixpacks for both WebSphere Application Server and the Java SDK occurred with WebSphere Application Server V8.0. Starting with WebSphere Application Server V8.0 and applicable to all subsequent releases and fixpacks, there is one install package that contains updates for both WebSphere Application Server and Java SDK.

Reference relevant evidence:
- `0d`: The IBM WebSphere Application Server Java SDK can be upgraded to the latest service release for the same Java SDK version.
- `0g`: WebSphere Application Server V8.0, V8.5, V8.5.5
- `0h`: Starting with V8.0 and applicable to all subsequent releases and fixpacks, there is one install package that contains updates for both WebSphere Application Server and Java SDK.

Support units:
- `E1.S1`: upgrade policy TECHNOTE (FAQ) QUESTION What is the Java™ SDK upgrade policy for the IBM® WebSphere® Application Server? CAUSE Updating to the latest compatible Java SDK could help you resolve problems more quickly. ANSWER The IBM WebSphere Application Server Java SDK can be upgraded to the latest service release for the same Java SDK version. List of WebSphere Application Server fix packs and the corresponding Java SDK versions [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=180&uid=swg27005002] Policy Summary by WebSphere Application Server release: WebSphere Application Server V8.0, V8.5, V8.5.5 Starting with V8.0 and applicable to all subsequent releases and fixpacks, there is one install package that contains updates for both WebSphere Application Server and Java SDK. Applying fixpacks of WebSphere Application Server also upgrades the SDK that is packaged and bundled within the fixpack. Additionally, separate Java SDK fixpacks are also available that contain just the SDK updates which can be applied to upgrade the SDK. WebSphere Application Server V7.0 Any V7.0 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.6.0 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server. WebSphere Application Server V6.1 Any V6.1 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.5.0 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server. WebSphere Application Server V6.0 Any V6.0 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.4.2 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server. WebSphere Application Server V5.1 Any V5.1 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.4.1 and any V5.1.1 can be upgraded to the latest Java SDK 1.4.2 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server. WebSphere Application Server V5.0 Any V5.0 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.3.1 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server. Details of Java SDK Upgrade Policy WebSphere Application Server leverages the Java SDK as a base component. This results in unique support issues, including: * Matching Java SDK service releases to Application Server releases and fix packs * Delivering updates and fixes associated with the Java SDK on any given Application Server release. In an effort to resolve customer Java SDK situations as quickly as possible, WebSphere Application Server Support has done a quickest-path-to-resolution analysis, determining the most direct way to collect problem information. In some cases, problem resolution might include finding shortcuts to resolve symptoms. One shortcut is an immediate upgrade to a newer compatible Java SDK service release, before gathering detailed problem determination data. There are multiple advantages to performing an immediate Java SDK upgrade as a quicker path to resolution over a full Problem Determination (PD) process: 1. There is a continuous stream of fixes going into the Java SDK. Many problems encountered by customers are resolved by these fixes. 2. When a new problem is encountered, applying the latest Java SDK is a quick way to determine if related fixes change the symptoms or correct the problem. 3. Many documented Java SDK fixes have common symptoms. Frequently, limited PD data

ERROR DESCRIPTION * Customer has uploaded the following IBM WebSphere SDK Java Technology Edition 7.1 fix package to the IBM Installation Manager Repository on the PureApplication System: 7.1.3.10_0001-WS-IBMWASJAVA-Linux.zip The package is not available from the instance console (maintenance operation) under "maintenance fixes" or "maintenance fixpacks". Since they cannot select it, they can not apply the fix to the virtual machine instances. LOCAL FIX * Use imcl manually to install the fix as described here: Why am I unable to install IBM WebSphere SDK Java Technology Edition 7.1 fix package from PureApplication System maintenance operations panel? https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/263001/why-am-i-unab [https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/263001/why-am-i-unab] le-to-install-ibm-websphere-sdk-java/ See also: Installation Manager Update Packages dialog does not list WebSphere Liberty https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/272058/installation- [https://developer.ibm.com/answers/questions/272058/installation-] manager-update-packages-dialog-does-n/ To confirm that APAR IT14680 is the root cause of a problem where a fix is not listed properly on the Manage > Maintenance page: Confirm that Installation Manager lists the fix as available: - SSH onto the virtual machine where the fix needs to be applied - Update your SSH tool settings so that the commands you issue and their output are saved in a file - Issue the following commands sudo -u virtuser ./imcl listAvailableFixes <fix-name> -repositories http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo [http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo] where <fix-name> is the name of the fix to be applied, for example: sudo -u virtuser ./imcl listAvailableFixes com.ibm.websphere.liberty.ND.v85_8.5.5009.20160227_1546 -repositories http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo [http://IBMWorkloadDeployer:8585/IMRepository/Compo] If an external Installation Manager Repository is also available, also issue sudo -u virtuser ./imcl listAvailableFixes <fix-name> -repositories http://<external-IM-repository> [http://<external-IM-repository>] where <fix-name> is the name of the fix to be applied, and <external-IM-repository> is the URL for the external IM repository. Enable tracing to collect logs with fixpack calculation information included: - Select System > Workload Troubleshooting - Add a trace for "com.ibm.maestro.mgmt.resources.IfixMgmtResource" - Set the trace level to ALL - Recreate the problem - Wait 2 hours - Select System > Workload Troubleshooting again - Download All Logs (take care *not* to choose Download Latest Logs) - Provide the trace.zip file to IBM support To review the logs for information - Unzip trace.zip and look for servers.zip - Unzip servers.zip - Unzip the Kernel Services logs inside servers.zip - Review the Kernel Services logs for log entries from IfixMgmtResource. PROBLEM SUMMARY * The code checking if a fix is applicable to a product installed on a virtual machine was expecting to compare versions for maintenance in the V.R.M.F formart (version, release, maintenance, fix). The Java fix had an unhandled version format. PROBLEM CONCLUSION * A code fix is being provided in PureApplication System version 2.2.0.0. The ZIP files in the download package section below can be used for setting up local repository to install SCA Fix Pack 1.0.1.19 using IBM Installation Manager. WebSphere Application Server feature packs are a mechanism for providing major new application server function between product releases. By delivering new functions and support for industry standards between product releases, you can more quickly explore and implement new technologies within your business applications in today's rapidly changing business environments. IBM WebSphere Application Server V7 Feature Pack for SCA [http://www.ibm.com/software/webservers/appserv/was/featurepacks/sca/] delivers critical technology that enables adoption of key Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) principles. As part of the larger SOA Foundation, which straddles all of IBM software brands, this offering delivers an integrated, open implementation of Service Component Architecture (SCA), a technology specified by IBM and other industry leaders through the Open SOA Collaboration (OSOA). For More details, visit the Information Center for SCA Feature Pack. ID: PI10514 Problem : Customer can launch IBM Installation Manager GUI, however, no text is displayed in the IBM Installation Manager main GUI; empty boxes are displayed without any fonts or text. The customer is unable to see available options, unable to navigate, or access other panels. It is determined that installing the following two X11 filesets on the AIX system resolves this problem. These filesets need to be added to the WebSphere Application Server information center as a requirement for AIX systems where WebSphere Application Server or IBM Installation manager GUI's are used: - X11.fnt.coreX - X11.fnt.iso_T1 This problem can also occur with the WebSphere Application Server GUIs; WebSphere customization toolbox,, profile management tool, or not installed. Support units:
- `E1.S1`: upgrade policy TECHNOTE (FAQ)
- `E1.S2`: QUESTION
 What is the Java™ SDK upgrade policy for the IBM® WebSphere® Application Server?
- `E1.S3`: CAUSE
Updating to the latest compatible Java SDK could help you resolve problems more quickly.
- `E1.S4`: ANSWER
The IBM WebSphere Application Server Java SDK can be upgraded to the latest service release for the same Java SDK version.
- `E1.S5`: List of WebSphere Application Server fix packs and the corresponding Java SDK versions [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?rs=180&uid=swg27005002]
- `E1.S6`: Policy Summary by WebSphere Application Server release:
- `E1.S7`: WebSphere Application Server V8.0, V8.5, V8.5.5
Starting with V8.0 and applicable to all subsequent releases and fixpacks, there is one install package that contains updates for both WebSphere Application Server and Java SDK. Applying fixpacks of WebSphere Application Server also upgrades the SDK that is packaged and bundled within the fixpack. Additionally, separate Java SDK fixpacks are also available that contain just the SDK updates which can be applied to upgrade the SDK.
- `E1.S8`: WebSphere Application Server V7.0
Any V7.0 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.6.0 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server.
- `E1.S9`: WebSphere Application Server V6.1
Any V6.1 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.5.0 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server.
- `E1.S10`: WebSphere Application Server V6.0
Any V6.0 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.4.2 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server.
- `E1.S11`: WebSphere Application Server V5.1
Any V5.1 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.4.1 and any V5.1.1 can be upgraded to the latest Java SDK 1.4.2 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server.
- `E1.S12`: WebSphere Application Server V5.0
Any V5.0 fix pack can upgrade to the latest Java SDK 1.3.1 service release packaged for WebSphere Application Server.
- `E1.S13`: Details of Java SDK Upgrade Policy
- `E1.S14`: WebSphere Application Server leverages the Java SDK as a base component. This results in unique support issues, including:
- `E1.S15`: * Matching Java SDK service releases to Application Server releases and fix packs
- `E1.S16`: * Delivering updates and fixes associated with the Java SDK on any given Application Server release.
- `E1.S17`: In an effort to resolve customer Java SDK situations as quickly as possible, WebSphere Application Server Support has done a quickest-path-to-resolution analysis, determining the most direct way to collect problem information.
- `E1.S18`: In some cases, problem resolution might include finding shortcuts to resolve symptoms. One shortcut is an immediate upgrade to a newer compatible Java SDK service release, before gathering detailed problem determination data.
- `E1.S19`: There are multiple advantages to performing an immediate Java SDK upgrade as a quicker path to resolution over a full Problem Determination (PD) process: 
 1. There is a continuous stream of fixes going into the Java SDK. Many problems encountered by customers are resolved by these fixes.
- `E1.S20`: 2. When a new problem is encountered, applying the latest Java SDK is a quick way to determine if related fixes change the symptoms or correct the problem.
- `E1.S21`: 3. Many documented Java SDK fixes have common symptoms. Frequently, limited PD data does not isolate the problem to a single root cause.
- `E1.S22`: These factors highlight the advantage of applying a newer Java SDK before working through a full PD cycle.
- `E2.S1`: SCA; Feature Pack for SCA; SCA Feature Pack Fix Pack 1.0.1.19 DOWNLOADABLE FILES ABSTRACT IBM WebSphere Application Server V7 Feature Pack for Service Component Architecture (SCA) Fix Pack 19 for distributed platforms, also known as SCA Feature Pack Fix Pack 1.0.1.19 DOWNLOAD DESCRIPTION SCA Feature Pack Fix Pack 1.0.1.19 is now available for your download through FTP and DD links by going to the Download Package section of this document. The ZIP files in the download package section below can be used for setting up local repository to install SCA Fix Pack 1.0.1.19 using IBM Installation Manager. WebSphere Application Server feature packs are a mechanism for providing major new application server function between product releases. By delivering new functions and support for industry standards between product releases, you can more quickly explore and implement new technologies within your business applications in today's rapidly changing business environments. IBM WebSphere Application Server V7 Feature Pack for SCA [http://www.ibm.com/software/webservers/appserv/was/featurepacks/sca/] delivers critical technology that enables adoption of key Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) principles. As part of the larger SOA Foundation, which straddles all of IBM software brands, this offering delivers an integrated, open implementation of Service Component Architecture (SCA), a technology specified by IBM and other industry leaders through the Open SOA Collaboration (OSOA). For More details, visit the Information Center for SCA Feature Pack. [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/wasinfo/fep/index.jsp?topic=/com.ibm.websphere.soafep.multiplatform.doc/info/ae/ae/csca_overview.html] Download Package Download Language Download options SCA V1.0.1.19 local repository US English FTP [ftp://public.dhe.ibm.com/software/websphere/downloads/sca/service/1.0/fixpacks/sca.1.0.1.19.fp.zip] WAS 7.0 local import repository US English FTP [ftp://public.dhe.ibm.com/software/websphere/downloads/was/import/was.7.0.import.zip] SCA V1.0 local import repository US English FTP [ftp://public.dhe.ibm.com/software/websphere/downloads/sca/import/sca.1.0.import.zip] Known Issues * OSGi Application Blueprint Service registrations fail. For details visit this Link [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24033832]. Change History * Nov 2, 2015: Published for SCA Fix Pack 19 (1.0.1.19) PREREQUISITES 1. If you are going to use IBM Installation Manager to import an existing WebSphere Application Server Version 7.0 installation that contains Version 1.0.0.x of the Feature Pack for SCA and then update it to Version 1.0.1.0, first use the Update Installer to remove any fixes that have been applied to the 1.0.0.x level using the Update Installer. 2. Install WebSphere Application Server Version 7.0.0.7 or later. 3. Install IBM Installation Manager. You can download and unpack a compressed file containing the IBM Installation Manager appropriate for your operating system from the IBM Installation Manager Web site [http://www.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg24023498]. You can then install IBM Installation Manager on your local system and use it to import WebSphere Application Server Version 7.0 as well as to install the feature pack from the Web-based repositories. 4. If you are using local repository for your installation, IBM Installation Manager must point to SCA local import repository in order to apply any future maintenance. It is available for download from the Download package section of this document. 5. The operating system requirements for a feature pack are the same as for the application server installation. However, you need to ensure that you have enough free disk space to install the feature pack onto the application server installation. Status: `ANSWER_STATE_VALID`; visible: `True`

Visible answer:
The change occurred starting with WebSphere Application Server V8.0. Beginning with V8.0 and all subsequent releases and fix packs, one install package contains updates for both WebSphere Application Server and the Java SDK; applying a WebSphere fix pack also upgrades the bundled SDK. Separate Java SDK-only fix packs remained available. [E1.S7]

For WebSphere V7.x, fix packs were still installed using the Update Installer, while Installation Manager was used for certain V7 feature-pack installations and maintenance. The evidence specifically describes installing the SCA feature pack on WAS V7.0.0.7 or later by first applying the WAS fix pack with Update Installer, then using Installation Manager for the feature pack and its fix packs. [E2.S1] [E3.S1]

### techqa_DEV_Q020#row-0078

Question: ODR OOM issue I got ODR OOM after upgrading the WAS to v8553. No configuration or traffic load changing. Is there any known way to solve the problem? 

Reference / gold answer:
Based on the provided context, there are no specific mentions of an ODR Out of Memory (OOM) issue directly related to upgrading WebSphere Application Server (WAS) to version 8.5.5. However, there are some recommendations and fixes provided for ODR-related issues in different versions of WebSphere products. 

To troubleshoot and potentially address the ODR OOM issue after upgrading to WAS v8553, you may consider the following general steps:
1. Check the release notes or known issues for WAS version 8.5.5 to see if there are any documented ODR-related issues or memory management updates.
2. Analyze memory usage on the server hosting the ODR to determine if it is indeed running out of memory.
3. Consider tuning the JVM memory settings for the ODR component to allocate more memory if needed.
4. Ensure that there are no memory leaks or inefficient processes causing the OOM error.
5. Contact IBM support for additional assistance or to inquire about any specific fixes or recommendations for ODR OOM issues related to the WAS v8553 upgrade.

Please note that addressing OOM issues can be complex and may require a detailed analysis of the system configuration and underlying causes of the problem.

- `E2.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 The Daeja Virtual viewer works as expected when accessing the node that hosts the viewer directly. 
However when the viewer is launched using the Load Balancer URL, it fails to load at all and only a white screen is seen in its place.
- `E2.S3`: SYMPTOM
Seen in place of viewer and loaded document:
- `E2.S4`: [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22008878&aid=1] [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg22008878&aid=1]
- `E2.S5`: CAUSE
Caching is enabled in the Websphere OnDemand Router (WAS ODR) and this causes WAS ODR to add its own cache control headers. These cache-control headers prevent the client PC from making the required callbacks to the back end webserver to obtain the resources it needs to start.
- `E2.S6`: ENVIRONMENT
Any load balanced environment using Webshere OnDemand Router (ODR)
- `E2.S7`: DIAGNOSING THE PROBLEM
To diagnose this issue, the developer tools in the browser need to be used to analyse the network requests.
- `E2.S8`: In the console log for the success case, you should see a call for "getViewoneBootstrap" - this call does not appear anywhere in the console in the failure case.
- `E2.S9`: From the network traces, the following differences can be seen:
- `E2.S10`: Request via Loadbalancer\ODR:
- `E2.S11`: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Powered-By: Servlet/3.0
Content-Type: text/css; charset=UTF-8
Cache-Control: max-age=86400
Last-Modified: Tue, XX Sep XXXX 18:35:44 GMT
Content-Language: en-GB
Date: Wed, XX Sep XXXX 10:32:55 GMT
Age: 13378
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Encoding: gzip
- `E2.S12`: Request to App server direct:
- `E2.S13`: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Powered-By: Servlet/3.0
Date: Wed, XX Sep XXXX 14:15:27 GMT
Content-Type: text/plain
Last-Modified: Wed, XX Jul XXXX 14:33:38 GMT
Content-Length: 9131
Content-Language: en-GB
- `E2.S14`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
Disable the WAS ODR caching completely form the Admin console:
- `E2.S15`: Servers -> On Demand Routers -> <ODR server name> -> On Demand Router Settings -> On Demand Router Properties -> On Demand Router settings
-> Caching
From here, uncheck the "Enable caching" tick box.
- `E2.S16`: Restart the application in full for the setting to take effect.
- `E2.S17`: RELATED INFORMATION
 WAS ODR Caching Configuration [https://www.ibm.com/support/knowledgecenter/en/SSAW57_8.5.5/com.ibm.websphere.nd.doc/ae/tjpx_cachestatdyn.html]

- `E4.S2`: PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 Your Web browser throws a 404 "File not found" error when trying to reach a Web page. When reviewing the local.log for the ODR server located in install_root/logs/<ODR> directory, you see the following error:
- `E4.S3`: <ip address> - - [02/Nov/2004:21:42:40 -0500] "GET /FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound HTTP/1.1" 404 0
- `E4.S4`: Note: The following is the Web page that you were trying to reach:
http://<hostname/ip address>:83/FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound
- `E4.S5`: CAUSE
The reason for the 404 error can be determined by recreating and tracing the ODR server and application server.
Tracing the application server using the following trace string:
- `E4.S6`: Servlet_Engine=all=enabled 
Tracing the ODR server using the following trace string:
- `E4.S7`: com.ibm.ws.proxy.*=all=enabled 
The following outlines two scenarios causing the 404 error:  * Scenario 1 - User Error
   This scenario reviews a common problem where the user types an invalid URL for their application. Reviewing the ODR server trace.log we can see the request arrive and the error message returned from the application server:
- `E4.S8`: [11/2/04 20:46:47:297 EST] 67f1de90 HttpProxyServ < requestArrived - Received request; method=GET uri=/FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@4fb0de9d connection link=HttpProxyConnectionLink@3c415e9d
   ...
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:906 EST] 4f655e93 HttpProxyServ < responseArrived
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:906 EST] 4f655e93 HttpProxyConn d Status code=Status code: 404 response body allowed; service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@4fb0de9d, connection link=HttpProxyConnectionLink@3c415e9d
   Reviewing the application server trace.log we can see the message arrive and the error message returned:
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:359 EST] 12d9f3a ServletReques > dispatchByURI
   /FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound
   ...
   [11/2/04 20:46:47:875 EST] 12d9f3a WebApp d Exception message=File not found: /CpuAndSleepBound
- `E4.S9`: * Scenario 2 - ODR Configuration
   This scenario reviews an ODR server configuration problem where an ODR server proxy port is not mapped to the appropriate virtual host. Reviewing the ODR server trace.log we can see the request arrive and then a 404 error because the ODR cannot properly map the request to an enterprise application:
- `E4.S10`: [11/2/04 21:42:40:156 EST] 6982e513 HttpProxyServ < requestArrived - Received request; method=GET uri=/FinancialAdvice/CpuAndSleepBound service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@5d426517 connection link=HttpProxyConnectionLink@5cd52517
   ...
   [11/2/04 21:42:40:156 EST] 6982e513 MapRequestFil d failed to map request to application: com.ibm.ws.http.channel.impl.HttpRequestMessageImpl@4a56515
   ...
   [11/2/04 21:42:40:172 EST] 6982e513 HttpFilterCha d Filter=HTTP Mapper generated error status code=Status code: 404 for service context=HttpProxyServiceContextImpl@5d426517. Generating error response and breaking request chaining.
- `E4.S11`: RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The following are the two solutions to the preceding scenarios.
- `E4.S12`: * Scenario 1 - User Error Solution
   Review the EAR file to determine the correct urls and if the url used above is valid. From the application.xml you can find the context root for the Web modules. Find the Web module, FinancialAdvice.war, that corresponds to the FinancialAdvice context root, shown below:
- `E4.S13`: <web-uri>FinancialAdvice.war</web-uri>
   <context-root>/FinancialAdvice</context-root> 
   From the web.xml file for the FinancialAdvice.war we can find all valid url patterns for the application. You should find the following if this was a valid URL: 
   <url-pattern>/CpuAndSleepBound</url-pattern> 
   But for this scenario, you would not find the preceeding xml entry in the web.xml because the Web page URL was invalid.
- `E4.S14`: * Scenario 2 - ODR Configuration Solution
   The proxy port setting for the ODR is not mapped to the appropriate virtual host group. This can be done using the administrative console:  1. Find the ODR proxy http  1. Expand the Servers topology
